items.quote: Are there any hotels in the dataset that have a star rating of 5? If yes, how many hotels have a star rating of 5?
items.description: 統計 star_rating 恰為 5 的飯店數，與 answer.txt 的 @total_hotels 值比對。

items.quote: Count only hotels that have a star rating exactly equal to 5. This count value should be a non-negative integer.
items.description: @total_hotels 必須存在且為非負整數。

items.quote:
Put each answer item on its own line, in the form `@name[value]`, using exactly the
names given under "Answer format" in the task.
items.description: answer.txt 需含 @total_hotels[value] 格式條目。
